notes.title: Seven Mysteries: The Last Page Patch 2.0.1 Now Available [09/28/19]
notes.content:
A new patch has been released for Seven Mysteries: The Last Page that consists of the following change:

► Fixed "The Last Page" achievement might not be activated when you read [b]Piece of Paper #11[/b].


Best Regards,

Sang Hendrix

notes.title: Seven Mysteries: The Last Page Patch 2.0.0 Now Available [02/14/18]
notes.content:
A new patch has been released for Seven Mysteries: The Last Page that consists of the following changes:

► New UI
► New resolution (16:9)
► Graphics improvement
► Faster Performances
► Mouse supports
► New language: Simplified Chinese
► Easier to get to chapter 7
► Bug fixed: FPS drops randomly

Before you update: All your save files on old version won’t work on this version. We're sorry for this inconvenience. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to tell us. :)

Best Regards,

Behind The Door Games
